data="-%20name%3A%20%22maxTokens%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%20%7C%20false%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Number%20of%20tokens%20to%20predict%20at%20most.%20If%20set%20to%20false%2C%20the%20model%20will%20predict%20as%20many%20tokens%20as%20it%20wants.%5Cn%5CnWhen%20the%20prediction%20is%20stopped%20because%20of%20this%20limit%2C%20the%20%60stopReason%60%20in%20the%20prediction%20stats%20will%20be%20set%20to%20%60maxPredictedTokensReached%60.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22temperature%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22The%20temperature%20parameter%20for%20the%20prediction%20model.%20A%20higher%20value%20makes%20the%20predictions%20more%20random%2C%20while%20a%20lower%20value%20makes%20the%20predictions%20more%20deterministic.%20The%20value%20should%20be%20between%200%20and%201.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22stopStrings%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22Array%3Cstring%3E%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22An%20array%20of%20strings.%20If%20the%20model%20generates%20one%20of%20these%20strings%2C%20the%20prediction%20will%20stop.%5Cn%5CnWhen%20the%20prediction%20is%20stopped%20because%20of%20this%20limit%2C%20the%20%60stopReason%60%20in%20the%20prediction%20stats%20will%20be%20set%20to%20%60stopStringFound%60.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22toolCallStopStrings%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22Array%3Cstring%3E%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22An%20array%20of%20strings.%20If%20the%20model%20generates%20one%20of%20these%20strings%2C%20the%20prediction%20will%20stop%20with%20the%20%60stopReason%60%20%60toolCalls%60.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22contextOverflowPolicy%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22LLMContextOverflowPolicy%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22The%20behavior%20for%20when%20the%20generated%20tokens%20length%20exceeds%20the%20context%20window%20size.%20The%20allowed%20values%20are%3A%5Cn%5Cn-%20%60stopAtLimit%60%3A%20Stop%20the%20prediction%20when%20the%20generated%20tokens%20length%20exceeds%20the%20context%20window%20size.%20If%20the%20generation%20is%20stopped%20because%20of%20this%20limit%2C%20the%20%60stopReason%60%20in%20the%20prediction%20stats%20will%20be%20set%20to%20%60contextLengthReached%60%5Cn-%20%60truncateMiddle%60%3A%20Keep%20the%20system%20prompt%20and%20the%20first%20user%20message%2C%20truncate%20middle.%5Cn-%20%60rollingWindow%60%3A%20Maintain%20a%20rolling%20window%20and%20truncate%20past%20messages.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22structured%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22ZodType%3CTStructuredOutputType%3E%20%7C%20LLMStructuredPredictionSetting%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Configures%20the%20model%20to%20output%20structured%20JSON%20data%20that%20follows%20a%20specific%20schema%20defined%20using%20Zod.%5Cn%5CnWhen%20you%20provide%20a%20Zod%20schema%2C%20the%20model%20will%20be%20instructed%20to%20generate%20JSON%20that%20conforms%20to%20that%20schema%20rather%20than%20free-form%20text.%5Cn%5CnThis%20is%20particularly%20useful%20for%20extracting%20specific%20data%20points%20from%20model%20responses%20or%20when%20you%20need%20the%20output%20in%20a%20format%20that%20can%20be%20directly%20used%20by%20your%20application.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22topKSampling%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Controls%20token%20sampling%20diversity%20by%20limiting%20consideration%20to%20the%20K%20most%20likely%20next%20tokens.%5Cn%5CnFor%20example%2C%20if%20set%20to%2040%2C%20only%20the%2040%20tokens%20with%20the%20highest%20probabilities%20will%20be%20considered%20for%20the%20next%20token%20selection.%20A%20lower%20value%20(e.g.%2C%2020)%20will%20make%20the%20output%20more%20focused%20and%20conservative%2C%20while%20a%20higher%20value%20(e.g.%2C%20100)%20allows%20for%20more%20creative%20and%20diverse%20outputs.%5Cn%5CnTypical%20values%20range%20from%2020%20to%20100.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22repeatPenalty%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%20%7C%20false%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Applies%20a%20penalty%20to%20repeated%20tokens%20to%20prevent%20the%20model%20from%20getting%20stuck%20in%20repetitive%20patterns.%5Cn%5CnA%20value%20of%201.0%20means%20no%20penalty.%20Values%20greater%20than%201.0%20increase%20the%20penalty.%20For%20example%2C%201.2%20would%20reduce%20the%20probability%20of%20previously%20used%20tokens%20by%2020%25.%20This%20is%20particularly%20useful%20for%20preventing%20the%20model%20from%20repeating%20phrases%20or%20getting%20stuck%20in%20loops.%5Cn%5CnSet%20to%20false%20to%20disable%20the%20penalty%20completely.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22minPSampling%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%20%7C%20false%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Sets%20a%20minimum%20probability%20threshold%20that%20a%20token%20must%20meet%20to%20be%20considered%20for%20generation.%5Cn%5CnFor%20example%2C%20if%20set%20to%200.05%2C%20any%20token%20with%20less%20than%205%25%20probability%20will%20be%20excluded%20from%20consideration.%20This%20helps%20filter%20out%20unlikely%20or%20irrelevant%20tokens%2C%20potentially%20improving%20output%20quality.%5Cn%5CnValue%20should%20be%20between%200%20and%201.%20Set%20to%20false%20to%20disable%20this%20filter.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22topPSampling%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%20%7C%20false%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Implements%20nucleus%20sampling%20by%20only%20considering%20tokens%20whose%20cumulative%20probabilities%20reach%20a%20specified%20threshold.%5Cn%5CnFor%20example%2C%20if%20set%20to%200.9%2C%20the%20model%20will%20consider%20only%20the%20most%20likely%20tokens%20that%20together%20add%20up%20to%2090%25%20of%20the%20probability%20mass.%20This%20helps%20balance%20between%20diversity%20and%20quality%20by%20dynamically%20adjusting%20the%20number%20of%20tokens%20considered%20based%20on%20their%20probability%20distribution.%5Cn%5CnValue%20should%20be%20between%200%20and%201.%20Set%20to%20false%20to%20disable%20nucleus%20sampling.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22xtcProbability%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%20%7C%20false%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Controls%20how%20often%20the%20XTC%20(Exclude%20Top%20Choices)%20sampling%20technique%20is%20applied%20during%20generation.%5Cn%5CnXTC%20sampling%20can%20boost%20creativity%20and%20reduce%20clich%C3%A9s%20by%20occasionally%20filtering%20out%20common%20tokens.%20For%20example%2C%20if%20set%20to%200.3%2C%20there's%20a%2030%25%20chance%20that%20XTC%20sampling%20will%20be%20applied%20when%20generating%20each%20token.%5Cn%5CnValue%20should%20be%20between%200%20and%201.%20Set%20to%20false%20to%20disable%20XTC%20completely.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22xtcThreshold%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%20%7C%20false%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Defines%20the%20lower%20probability%20threshold%20for%20the%20XTC%20(Exclude%20Top%20Choices)%20sampling%20technique.%5Cn%5CnWhen%20XTC%20sampling%20is%20activated%20(based%20on%20xtcProbability)%2C%20the%20algorithm%20identifies%20tokens%20with%20probabilities%20between%20this%20threshold%20and%200.5%2C%20then%20removes%20all%20such%20tokens%20except%20the%20least%20probable%20one.%20This%20helps%20introduce%20more%20diverse%20and%20unexpected%20tokens%20into%20the%20generation.%5Cn%5CnOnly%20takes%20effect%20when%20xtcProbability%20is%20enabled.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22cpuThreads%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22number%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22Specifies%20the%20number%20of%20CPU%20threads%20to%20allocate%20for%20model%20inference.%5Cn%5CnHigher%20values%20can%20improve%20performance%20on%20multi-core%20systems%20but%20may%20compete%20with%20other%20processes.%20For%20example%2C%20on%20an%208-core%20system%2C%20a%20value%20of%204-6%20might%20provide%20good%20performance%20while%20leaving%20resources%20for%20other%20tasks.%5Cn%5CnIf%20not%20specified%2C%20the%20system%20will%20use%20a%20default%20value%20based%20on%20available%20hardware.%22%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20%22draftModel%22%0A%20%20type%3A%20%22string%22%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%20%20description%3A%20%22The%20draft%20model%20to%20use%20for%20speculative%20decoding.%20Speculative%20decoding%20is%20a%20technique%20that%20can%20drastically%20increase%20the%20generation%20speed%20(up%20to%203x%20for%20larger%20models)%20by%20paring%20a%20main%20model%20with%20a%20smaller%20draft%20model.%5Cn%5CnSee%20here%20for%20more%20information%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Flmstudio.ai%2Fdocs%2Fadvanced%2Fspeculative-decoding%5Cn%5CnYou%20do%20not%20need%20to%20load%20the%20draft%20model%20yourself.%20Simply%20specifying%20its%20model%20key%20here%20is%20enough.%22"
